content:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Metering pipeline: token-emit-rate spike detected for customer shard sh-17. anomaly_score=0.92 :rotating_light:
oncall-frontend: on it — paging SRE. passing to @sre-aly
sre-aly: acked. starting triage, will check emitter logs and redis counters
eng-metering: I see increased duplicate ack counts on emitter-3 in eu-west-1, pushing tail logs now
sre-aly: paste the tail when you have it
eng-metering: ```
2026-03-17T09:41:02Z emitter-3 INFO emitted 1200 tokens batch_id=abc123 seq=...
2026-03-17T09:41:03Z emitter-3 WARN replay-detected duplicate=true orig_batch=abc122
```
billing-ops: customers are seeing overage flags — a handful have alerts firing. list incoming
product-csm: flagged two customers in PROD /acct/543 and /acct/998, they got emails about unexpected usage. CSM on call pinged them
oncall-frontend: good to know customer impact. what's the scope?
sre-aly: preliminary: spike originates from emitter replay loop causing ~30-40% inflation of token counts for some windows. not global yet
infra-jun: checked redis counters — some shards show counter jumps and short-term TTL resets, looks like replays cause double-emit and keys TTL dropping to 0 then re-accumulating
eng-metering: rolling a quick patch to suppress duplicate acks on emitter-3, will push a hotfix (non-disruptive)
sre-aly: while patch lands, can we mute overage alerting and prevent customer-facing emails?
billing-ops: muting outgoing overage notifications now (alert-rule:billing-overage-email -> mute). will add note to ticket
product-csm: thanks — CSMs notified to hold customer outreach until we confirm real counts
eng-metering: hotfix deployed to emitter-3 (sha: d4c7). set debug logging to trace for 5m. reverting duplicate path on emitter-3
sre-aly: run a quick query to compare emitter counts vs ledger ingest for shard sh-17
eng-metering: query: ```SELECT sum(tokens_emitted) FROM emitter_metrics WHERE shard='sh-17' AND ts > now() - interval '10 minutes';```
eng-metering: result: emitted=1,220,340 ingest_ack=915,270 
sre-aly: 33% delta — consistent with duplication hypothesis
infra-jun: starting a backfill to reconcile ingest ledger with emitter counts for affected windows; will run in dry-run first
eng-metering: enabling conservative dedupe at router (config: dedupe_window_ms=200) to reduce duplicates in-flight
incident-bot: Pager duty: handoff scheduled in 25m to next oncall
oncall-frontend: Aly — do you want a formal pager handoff or stay until resolved?
sre-aly: I'll stay for the next 30m then hand to infra-jun. leave critical page policy unchanged
billing-ops: customer alerts muted. internal dashboard now shows 'suspected-inflation' tag on affected accounts
product-csm: packing note for CSMs: do not promise credits yet, awaiting reconciliation report
eng-metering: started reconciliation dry-run output (snippet): ```sh
> reconcile --shard sh-17 --window 2026-03-17T09:30:00Z/09:45:00Z --mode dry-run
Potential adjustment: acct/543 delta=-32000 tokens
Potential adjustment: acct/998 delta=-41000 tokens
```
sre-aly: looks reasonable. if backfill confirms, we will adjust billing counts and unflag overages
billing-ops: prepare email template for reversal/clarification if customers already saw messages
product-csm: I have one customer already replied asking for explanation. I'll hold on response until we confirm reconciliation
eng-metering: dry-run succeeded; running actual reconcile now (starting 2-step: ledger correction then upstream marker to avoid double-process)
infra-jun: applying consumer checkpoint to prevent reprocessing duplicates during reconcile
incident-bot: [INFO] reconcile job job-887 started by eng-metering
sre-aly: monitoring ingestion lag and token totals. sharing quick metrics: ingest-lag=12s -> 3s after reconcile started, token-delta shrinking to ~5%
eng-metering: reconcile complete. adjustments applied. new emit vs ingest comparison: emitted=1,224,100 ingest=1,205,900 delta=1.5%
billing-ops: unmuting alerts but suppressing automatic emails for 15m while we verify customer-facing state
product-csm: sending controlled note to impacted customers: "We've identified an emission duplication in our metering pipeline affecting a small subset of accounts. We've corrected the counts and removed incorrect overage flags. No billing adjustments are needed for most customers; if your account saw a notice, we'll follow up with a corrective statement." (will wait for legal review)
sre-aly: next steps: postmortem, root cause: emitter retry logic + short TTL on counters allowed duplicates to be counted twice. engineering action items: increase counter TTL behavior, add idempotency markers, extend dedupe window, add more granular metrics for replay detection
eng-metering: creating PRs: #452-add-idempotency, #453-dedupe-window-config. estimated remediation rollout next week
infra-jun: will add k8s liveness check to emitter-ack handler to avoid TTL resets we saw
billing-ops: creating billing ticket to credit any customers where reconcile indicates non-zero net cost impact. tagging legal & finance
product-csm: thanks. I'll draft customer comms and coordinate with billing ticket
incident-bot: [RESOLVED] Metering spike mitigated — final checks passed. duration 00:41:20
sre-aly: leaving note: handoff to infra-jun for follow-ups, marking incident P1 -> will schedule postmortem for tomorrow 10:00am PT
oncall-frontend: thx all. great quick work. :thumbsup:
billing-ops: adding post-incident customer outreach plan to the billing ticket
eng-metering: logging final artifacts and uploading debug dump to /incidents/1733334444/artifacts
product-csm: closing loop with CSM team, will share summary after postmortem
incident-bot: ticket created: INC-2026-0317-0023 (link)
